question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution:
The correct answer is "l**andlady.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The blank 2 will mention the person having an angry nature.
 
• **Now, the subject of the passage is referring to her house, in which she currently lives and her old house as well.**
 
• Thus, in this context the correct word to use is "landlady.&
